findings.summary: The new os.Chmod runs on every SaveUploadedFile call, even without perm, and chmods the existing parent directory (e.g. '.', '/tmp', '/'), which can fail with EPERM or alter shared directory permissions; it should apply only to directories MkdirAll created and only when perm is passed.

The perm argument is applied only to the directory and never to the saved file (still created with os.Create default mode), which is misleading; a value like 0o644 leaves the directory untraversable, and only perm[0] is used with extra values silently ignored.
TestSaveUploadedFileWithPermission saves into the current directory, asserts on and chmods the package/repo directory, and leaves a file behind; it should use t.TempDir() and a subdirectory.
The 'Failed' permission test doesn't fail when run as root, writes test/permission_test into the package directory when it doesn't fail, and doesn't clean up.
